features.title: Validate and forward a well-formed feed
features.intent: A well-formed feed passes validation and is forwarded byte-identical.
features.serves: REQ-AC1: clean feeds must pass through unchanged
acceptance: A well-formed feed passes validation and reaches the intake queue byte-identical.

features.title: Quarantine a malformed feed with a precise report
features.intent: A feed with a wrong date format is quarantined with the offending field and line in the report.
features.serves: REQ-AC2: broken feeds must be quarantined with actionable errors
acceptance: A feed with a wrong date format is quarantined and the report names the offending field and line.

features.title: Normalize non-UTF-8 encodings
features.intent: A feed with a non-UTF-8 encoding is normalized to UTF-8 and passed through.
features.serves: REQ-AC3: encoding defects must not corrupt the pipeline
acceptance: A feed encoded in a non-UTF-8 charset is normalized to UTF-8 and forwarded.
